# HBO Max

> > HBO Max (now Max) is a premium streaming service from WarnerMedia offering original series, movies, live sports including MLB, NHL, NCAA March Madness, and U.S. Soccer, plus content from HBO, CNN Max, and Warner Media studios.

This site provides brand resources, support documentation, and subscription information for HBO Max's streaming platform. It includes comprehensive help centers in multiple languages, brand guidelines for marketing partners, and detailed plan comparisons across Basic with Ads, Standard, and Premium tiers.

## Key Topics

- HBO Max streaming service
- Max rebranding
- Subscription plans (Basic with Ads, Standard, Premium)
- WarnerMedia content
- CNN Max integration
- Live sports streaming (MLB, NHL, NCAA, U.S. Soccer)
- Brand guidelines and design system
- Account management and billing
- Multi-platform support (Apple App Store, Amazon Appstore)
- International availability
- Troubleshooting and technical support
- Marketing resources and brand assets
- Competitive positioning (vs Disney+, Hulu, BluTV)

## Subscription Plans & Pricing

- [HBO Max Subscription Plans Comparison](https://help.hbomax.com/us/Answer/Detail/000002547): Subscription plan comparison: Basic with Ads, Standard, and Premium tiers
